result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and wide sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and a refuge island. The wide roadway and multiple travel lanes increase pedestrian exposure during crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide safe crossing times at this signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
